content.user_title: Build React Native Apps with Expo
content.value_statement: Mobile teams need fast guidance for React Native setup, components, and platform checks. This skill provides Expo commands, component patterns, and troubleshooting steps in one place.
actual_capabilities: Lists npm and Expo commands for starting, running, installing packages, and prebuilding native code.
Provides a reusable React Native component pattern with StyleSheet styling.
Shows platform-specific rendering and values with Platform.OS and Platform.select.
Covers FlatList, TextInput, and ActivityIndicator examples for common screens.
Gives troubleshooting steps for Metro, native modules, builds, and simulators.
limitations: Does not include full project scaffolding files or dependency versions.
Does not verify commands against a specific app environment.
Does not cover native iOS or Android code in depth.
Does not provide release signing or app store submission workflows.

use_cases.title: Start a mobile project
use_cases.description: Use the setup commands and Expo guidance to begin a React Native app quickly.

use_cases.title: Build reusable screens
use_cases.description: Use the component, list, form, and loading patterns while building app screens.

use_cases.title: Standardize mobile guidance
use_cases.description: Share one concise reference for team workflows, platform checks, and common fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Start an Expo app
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up an Expo React Native project. Include the commands to start Metro and run iOS or Android.

prompt_templates.title: Create a component
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a React Native component plan for a reusable button. Include props, styling, accessibility, and press behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Fix platform behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this mobile screen behavior for iOS and Android. Suggest platform-specific rendering, values, and styles.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a mobile workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my React Native project goals and propose a workflow covering components, forms, lists, troubleshooting, and platform checks.

output_examples.input: I need a reusable mobile button for a React Native app.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a component plan with props, touch handling, StyleSheet styling, and accessibility labels.

output_examples.input: Metro does not start after dependency changes.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests cache clearing, dependency checks, app configuration review, and simulator reset steps.

output_examples.input: My screen needs different spacing on iOS and Android.
output_examples.output: The skill explains platform checks, selected values, and style changes for each mobile platform.

best_practices: Confirm the target platform before applying platform-specific guidance.
Pair command suggestions with the project package manager and app configuration.
Add accessibility labels and roles when creating interactive components.
anti_patterns: Do not assume Expo commands fit every bare React Native project.
Do not skip testing on both iOS and Android when behavior differs.
Do not copy troubleshooting commands without checking local changes first.

faq.question: Can this skill create a complete mobile app?
faq.answer: It guides setup and patterns, but it does not ship a complete project by itself.

faq.question: Does it support Expo?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Expo start, install, and prebuild commands.

faq.question: Can it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: It lists common npm and Expo commands. Execution depends on the user tool settings and approval process.

faq.question: Does it handle native modules?
faq.answer: It provides prebuild and troubleshooting guidance. Deep native code changes need project-specific review.

faq.question: Is it useful for accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It reminds authors to add accessibility labels and roles to interactive components.

faq.question: Does it replace official documentation?
faq.answer: No. It links to official React Native and Expo documentation for current platform details.
